notes.title: WE’RE COOKED
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]We have decided to delay the launch of Brew.[/p][p][/p][p]As you can guess, it is due to Hades II launching on the same day as Brew. Not only is Hades II an amazing game (that the team will be playing), the original Hades was one of our main inspirations for Brew and we do not want to ruin Supergiant's launch, jk jk.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to give Brew the best chance possible for players to find Brew and for our hard work to shine. The extra time will also give us more time to perfect and polish the experience for all of you. Honestly, can’t believe we chose the same month as indie juggernauts Silksong and Hades II. It's a great time to be a gamer.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, here's a sneak peak of things to come:[/p][p]Watch on Bluesky: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/snowleafstudios.bsky.social/post/3lyxp365qgs2s"]https://bsky.app/profile/snowleafstudios.bsky.social/post/3lyxp365qgs2s[/url][/p][p]Watch on X/Twitter: [url="https://x.com/SnowLeafStudios/status/1967982616159944812"]https://x.com/SnowLeafStudios/status/1967982616159944812[/url][/p]

notes.title: Brew releases 1st of October 2025
notes.notes: [p][i]❗️EDIT: We have a new release date! September 25th! See [/i][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1793330/view/523100892744909769"]here[/url][/i][i] for more.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p]We are extremely excited to share that Brew will release on:[/p][h2]🐭[b]1st October 2025[/b]🐭[/h2][p]Thank you so much for the support, feedback and engagement. We look forward to get Brew into your hands. This has been an incredible journey for us since we started working on Brew with the concept back in Fall 2021.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gamescom 2025[/h2][p]We are participating in Gamescom & Anthro Festival with Brew. You can find a lot of cool Anthro games in the Steam Festival event (banner at the Brew store page). Also, here is picture from Gamescom. With a cosplay of the mouse by the amazing 8Z Cosplay![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/27343e0fb15fa84077757ce04a460b02a88e0e25.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Chinese language support [/h2][p]We also are happy to share that Brew will support Chinese traditional and Chinese simplified. This means that you can now play the Brew demo in Chinese. Huge thanks to AnJetCat for the translation and LQA work, it has been absolutely amazing to see our community help us out. Thank you so much AnJetCat 🐭[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/b7523798c606f43def91529b0fcc18a272e2ce0c.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope to bring more language support in the future![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much and we hope you are as excited as we are for release🐭[/p][p]Snow Leaf team[/p]

notes.title: NEW DEMO BUILD OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Brew demo is getting another update! This time we are also announcing our participation in Steam Next Fest this June. More builds will be published up to the start of the fest, 9th of June.
Hope you guys enjoy the new DEMO!

The Demo includes a small part of the game and does not reflect the final version of the game. The demo contains the following content:
[list]
[*] HUB
[*] 1 out of 4 floors
[*] 1 boss
[*] A few of the students at the academy
[*] Some upgrades
[/list]

Join our discord to discuss the game and to give us feedback and bug-reports: https://discord.gg/MAEy2SSkqC

notes.title: Demo Patch April 2025
notes.notes:
In February, we released the Brew Demo.
The demo will be updated periodically and it will stay up until the release of the game.

In the demo, we showcased the first day of arriving at the Alchemy Academy, along with a peek at the Mechanology floor and the duel against Professor Akilah. We also had a bunch of friendship events for you to unlock in the Academy Grounds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/c1a405221a7319c37684cc8390f0211abdb6005c.png[/img]
[h3][b]Features [/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new break room to the tower, the Shop!
[*] Added explanation cards with video to the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance changes 
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added direct impact damage to the water grenade launcher
[*] Increased Shield Guy's jump attack damage (5 - 12)
[/list]
[h3][b]Sound Effects
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added firing sounds to the air sniper when you're not at the sweet spot.
[*] Made a new sound for the sniper
[*] Removed the clap sound when reaching the sweet spot
[*] Added a charge sound
[*] Updated the Water Grenade gun sounds
[*] Updated the Shotgun sounds
[*] Added new chest sounds
[*] Fixed a bug with the sound location of the shield guy laser, often making it inaudible.
[*] Updated the Crab locomotion sounds
[*] Updated double jump sounds
[*] Updated the sounds of destructables
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/6a5830446f16f91653be53cc02ac17386eaa6e4a.png[/img]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes and Misc Changes 
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Made corks spawn in a more satisfying way
[*] Shield guy
[list]
[*] Set a minimum laser distance
[*] Fixed bug where Shield Guy Rocket indicators were invisible
[*] Replaced Shield Guy Rocket VFX and indicator VFX
[/list]
[*] Removed some rough WIP features hidden in the Hub
[*] Disabled potion upgrade with unintended behavior (fire shotgun)
[*] Changed collision on enemies to work with water dash
[*] Fixed the fire dash upgrade
[*] Possibly fixed an obscure crash happening to about 1% of our players :(
[*] Changed the visuals of hovered buttons from darkening the button to a background glow, to make it more clear what is hovered or not.
[*] Fixed a possible infinite loop with a specific badge combination
[*] Fixed water splash spawning multiple times on the water grenade
[*] Removed badges from the tutorial
[*] Updated the basic attack VFX
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481987/0ab891b1cb73f296972b2d26a93d54ffbfcd1d37.png[/img]

Did you know that there are friendship events for each character in the demo? 
You must become friends with them to unlock them, but event Newt and Aster have extra events!

[h3]Thank you all for playing the demo and following the development of Brew! We cannot wait to show off more of the features we have been working on behind the scenes…[/h3]

Wishlist, follow and get the demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793330/Brew/
